name: Glarcherhof - Ferienhof Thaler
beschreibung: The Glarcherhof - Ferienhof Thaler is located in Thiersee in Tirol. It is an inn with overnight accommodation. The restaurant offers regional cuisine. The location is quiet and close to nature. Guests can hike in summer and ski in winter. Thiersee is known for its lake and the mountains. The farm is run by the Thaler family.
